objective: Estimate compound potency and maximal response across independent experiments within the prespecified usable dose range.

questions.text: What are the EC50 and maximal response after excluding cytotoxic or assay-interfering doses by rule?

inputs.description: Well-level response, viability, dose, control, plate, and experiment records.

units.description: Independent biological experiment performed on a different day.
Assay plate nested within an experiment.
Technical well nested within a plate.

outcomes.definition: Response normalized to vehicle and positive controls after plate QC.

analysis_sets.definition: Independent experiments whose vehicle and positive controls meet prespecified assay criteria.

restrictions: Do not infer clinical dosing from this in-vitro assay.

steps.purpose: Apply control, range, cytotoxicity, and interference rules without inspecting the desired effect.
steps.method: Prespecified plate and dose exclusion criteria.

steps.purpose: Estimate potency and maximal response with between-experiment uncertainty.
steps.method: Four-parameter logistic model with experiment-aware uncertainty and prespecified fallback.

required_outputs.description: EC50, maximal response, uncertainty, experiment count, and model diagnostics.
Observed independent-experiment summaries and fitted curve with uncertainty.

validation.criterion: Every included experiment satisfies the vehicle and positive-control criteria.

dose_response.response_definition: Percent activation normalized to vehicle and positive controls.
dose_response.primary_estimand: EC50 and maximal normalized response across valid independent experiments.
dose_response.toxicity_or_interference_rule: Exclude doses with median viability below 70 percent before fitting the response curve.
